t: The LAP Juventas fixed fire rated downlight provides reliable indoor illumination. This downlight is ideal for domestic settings, including bathrooms and kitchens, offering a practical lighting solution. It is fire rated to 30, 60, and 90 minutes for enhanced safety and features an IP65 rating, making it suitable for bathroom zone 2 installations. The unit includes a stylish black bezel and a durable plastic body. Designed for straightforward installation with a 75mm cut-out and loop in/loop out terminals, it requires one GU10 light bulb (sold separately) and is dimmable when used with a compatible rotary switch.
